turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My grandma's old wooden chair has a wobbly leg and I really want to save it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could squeeze some wood glue into the loose joint and clamp it overnight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or take the whole chair apart, clean off the old glue, and reglue every joint.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or bring it to the furniture restorer in town, who's lovely but expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Since it's your grandma's and means a lot, I'd lean towards doing it properly. Either take it apart yourself carefully, or let the restorer handle it so you don't risk cracking anything.
